name: Vidush Raj Selvaraj
title: AI Engineer
tagline: I architect intelligent AI systems - agents that talk, reason, retrieve, and act and integrate them into production-ready, full-scale SaaS applications.
summary: AI Engineer with 2+ years of experience building and deploying production-grade Generative AI systems, multi-agent workflows and real-time voice assistants, grounded in a First-Class Honours BEng in Software Engineering.

Hands-on across the Google Cloud AI stack, the Microsoft AI stack and Google Workspace automation. I build MCP servers, implement RAG on managed and open-source platforms, and advise companies on AI architecture.

points: Engineered AXON, a multi-lingual AI voice assistant, with Python, FastAPI, WebSockets and the Gemini Live API.
Built WebRTC voice activity detection for interruptions and connected the assistant to PBX networks via MCP for autonomous call routing.
Built multi-agent systems with Google ADK and A2A on Vertex AI, and trained, fine-tuned and deployed models there.
Designed a secure RAG pipeline with Cohere and Qdrant, plus managed RAG with Vertex AI RAG Engine and Azure AI Search.
Deployed stateless backends on Cloud Run with Secret Manager, Cloud IAM and Speech-to-Text V2.
Advised companies on AI architecture: solution design, LLM and cloud choices, managed versus open-source RAG.
Deployed secure RAG pipelines and n8n workflows for data extraction and business processes.
Replaced legacy applications with autonomous multi-agent workflows using LangChain, OpenAI and Gemini.
Ran manual and regression testing for the app and website, with documented test plans.
Worked with developers in Agile sprints to reproduce and fix critical bugs, tracked in ClickUp.
